_comment: What the three client verifiers in this directory are measured on.
The clients implement the integrity tiers only (L1-L3 in CONFORMANCE.md's
canonical model; 'integrity' is the documented shorthand for L1-L3): the
COSE_Sign1 checkpoint signature and the RFC 9162 Merkle root over the events
a record carries. The governance and ground-truth checks (L4) ship in the Go
Each client's conformance test enumerates vectors/crypto/manifest.json and
derives its expectations from this file, so a vector added to the suite
changes what CI demands of every client without anyone editing a test. A
vector whose kind is listed in neither array fails the test by design: new
coverage must be declared here deliberately, not absorbed silently.
_out_of_scope_comment: Reject vectors whose failure is above the integrity tier. These records are
cryptographically intact and an integrity-tier verifier MUST accept them:
rejecting one would mean the client is guessing at a tier it does not
implement. The suite still carries them so the boundary is tested, not assumed.
